🟠 [cap-formula] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 computes `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` instead of the spec's 50 % rounded down; replace with `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`
🟠 [clamp-upper] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 caps quantity at 98 (`Math.min(98, …)`) but the spec requires 1..99 inclusive; change to `Math.min(99, …)`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount ten times too small; change divisor to 100
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of the spec's 30 cents; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses `Math.round` but the spec says "one point per full 100 cents (round down)"; use `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
🟠 [minorder-boundary] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000` but "at least 1000 cents" requires `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-dir] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses `Math.min(100, …)` capping the fee at 100, but the spec's "but at least 100 cents" requires the fee (or the refund floor) to use `Math.max`; replace `Math.min` with `Math.max`
🟠 [ship-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)` but "each started additional 500 g" requires `Math.ceil(extra / 500)`; e.g. 1001 g should cost 600 not 500
🟠 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem` giving rem+1 shares an extra cent so the array sums to total+1; change to `i < rem`
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of the spec's 10000 basis-point denominator, inflating tax ten-fold; change divisor to 10000

campaign_receipt.reason: acceptance-bound policy requires explicit depth-0 authority for every non-exact finding

MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of 30, understating every card fee; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round, so 150 cents awards 2 points instead of 1 full-hundred point; change to `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, so an order of exactly 1000 cents fails the "at least 1000" check; change to `cents >= 1000`
MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min, making the fee at most 100 cents instead of at least 100 cents, so large refunds are over-refunded; change to `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`

MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, so tax is ten times the basis-point rate and checkoutTotal and invoiceLine inherit the error; change `/ 1000` to `/ 10000`

MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem`, so rem+1 shares each get an extra cent and the array sums to total+1 (splitCents(100, 2) returns [51,50] summing 101); change the condition to `i < rem`

- [prior:s1.coupon-divisor] | major | src/coupon.js:5 | MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon is one tenth of the correct discount and checkoutTotal inherits the error; change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`

- [prior:s1.minimum-exclusive] | major | src/minorder.js:4 | MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, so an order of exactly 1000 cents fails the "at least 1000" check; change to `cents >= 1000`

- [prior:s1.refund-fee-min] | major | src/refund.js:4 | MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min, making the fee at most 100 cents instead of at least 100 cents, so large refunds are over-refunded; change to `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`
